_about: Example only. Copy to a file outside the repository (or to config.json next to this file, which git ignores), set data_root to the folder that holds the field data, and pass it with --config or the environment variable UBTS_DRIVE_RESPONSE_CONFIG. Relative entries are resolved against data_root; an absolute entry is used as it is.
